articles.title: Standard Chartered brings spot crypto trading to Dubai FX platform
articles.snippet: The bank is now offering institutional crypto spot trading in the region, bringing BTC and ETH onto the same eFX rails that institutions use to trade dollars and euros.

articles.title: VARA, Securitize sign MoU for tokenization innovation in Dubai
articles.snippet: VARA and Securitize signed an MoU to foster more tokenization innovation in Dubai and explore how tokenized financial innovation should be regulated in the region.

articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-6 Astra: The Closest AI Model Yet to AGI
articles.snippet: The model can independently discover and exploit unknown security flaws across hardened systems, triggering a staged rollout and White House review before public access.

articles.title: Kalshi Suspends House Candidate Laurie Buckhout for Betting on Herself
articles.snippet: The North Carolina Republican bought less than $1,000 of contracts on her own race and drew a three-year ban.

articles.title: Anthropic Ships Claude Fable 5.1, More Than Doubling Its Predecessor on Key Benchmark
articles.snippet: Fable 5.1 and its restricted sibling Mythos 5.1 arrive three months after export controls forced Anthropic to pull Fable 5 offline for 18 days
